completed_in_this_session: META CONVERSIONS API for Purchase, server-side (§8.30-l). Sent from notifyPaid, which is reached only behind markPaid returning "paid" - so it inherits exactly-once and never-throw from the receipt email rather than re-earning them. Deduplicated against the browser event by purchaseEventId(orderRef) = purchase_KH-XXXX-XXXX, which both sides derive independently with no shared state.

NO PUBLIC /api/capi ENDPOINT, deliberately, against the guide that asked for one: that route would let anyone on the internet write fake purchases into the ad account, and would have had the browser POST the customer email and phone in the clear to be hashed. Only a purchase Razorpay confirmed can report one, and only SHA-256 leaves.

NEW COLUMN preorders.fb_attrib (nullable jsonb, founder ran the migration 2026-09-02), mirroring how utm was already done. It holds _fbp, _fbc, client IP and user agent, captured in create-order because the webhook is called by Razorpay and carries none of the customer request. ALL read server-side from the request the browser already sends - no client change at all, and no new say for the client.

META_CAPI_TOKEN added to lib/store/env.ts as OPTIONAL (absent = server Purchase skipped, browser pixel carries on) and to test/store-secrets.test.ts as a real secret that may never take a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name. VERIFIED after build: the token appears nowhere in .next/static and neither does the CAPI code. META_CAPI_TEST_CODE is development-only.

THREE CLAIMS IN THE EXTERNAL REVIEW WERE FALSE about this codebase and were NOT acted on. (1) "Purchase on /thanks has no de-dup guard": there is no pixel call in /thanks at all - Purchase fires in Razorpay success handler, once per payment, so a refresh or an email-link return cannot re-fire it. (2) "Add Lead on contact form submit": /contact has NO form, only WhatsApp and mailto links. (3) "NEXT_PUBLIC_META_PIXEL_ID already set in Vercel / enabled on Preview": no such env var exists, the id is hardcoded, and previews are excluded by the HOSTNAME gate - so previews were never sending events.

REAL DEFECT FIXED from that review: resolveTier returned event_tiers.amount_paise unvalidated, so a 0 or null row rendered a live "Pay ₹0 and reserve" button - and Razorpay REFUSES a ₹0 order, so the parent got a dead button on a payment page with no explanation. Now refused as an invalid tier. Only reachable via a signed event-tier link, never the main store.

⚠ OPEN AND NOT CLAUDE-FIXABLE: Meta Automatic Advanced Matching is ON BY DEFAULT and scrapes the pre-order form, which makes the LIVE /privacy page untrue - it promises no tool is ever sent a name, phone, email or the child age. Founder must either switch AAM off in Events Manager (two clicks, page becomes true again) or ask for §8.30-g to be rewritten a second time. Law recorded as §8.30-m.

PRIVACY REWRITTEN A SECOND TIME, and this one was OUR OWN doing (§8.30-n). The Conversions API shipped 2026-09-02 sends a SHA-256 of the parent email, phone and first name, while /privacy still promised no tool "is ever sent your name, your address, your phone number, your email". Code and sentence shipped a day apart and contradicted each other. Founder chose option B: keep the matching, disclose it. The page now says at pre-order Meta is sent a ONE-WAY CODE made from email, phone and first name, that it cannot be turned back into the details, and that the details themselves are never sent. Two promises survive and are now enforced against meta-capi.ts itself: the delivery address and anything about the child are never sent.

AAM DECIDED: KEPT ON, ALL FIELDS (founder, 2026-09-02, after being recommended off twice). Do not re-raise. Consequence handled the same day: AAM scrapes what Meta's script recognises, including city/state/pincode from the address form on /thanks, so /privacy STOPPED promising "your delivery address is never sent" and "nothing about your child is ever sent". Both are now BANNED by test so they cannot come back while AAM is on. Replacement wording is category-level at the founder's direction ("keep it vague, think like a lawyer") - a legitimate drafting choice, and the line held was that nothing on the page DENIES something that happens. Noted to the founder once: under DPDP §5 a vaguer notice is a weaker position, not a safer one, because clear itemised notice is what evidences notice was given. Page stays counsel-gated. Law §8.30-o.

SETTLED 2026-09-02, and recorded so it stops recurring (§8.30-p): "Purchase fires on /thanks and needs a re-fire guard" is FALSE and was raised THREE times. No guard added, and deliberately NOT logged as a known limitation, because a documented limitation that does not exist gets re-raised every quarter until somebody fixes it. Purchase fires from Razorpay's success handler in PreorderForm.tsx, which never renders on /thanks; that page renders AddressForm, whose only analytics call is addressSaved. WHY IT LOOKS TRUE, and this is the reusable part: Purchase, eventID and thanks all sit in the SAME built JS chunk because Next groups routes into shared chunks - co-location is not a call site. GREP THE SOURCE, NOT THE BUNDLE. Same family as §8.25-bb, where grepping HTML found strings that lived only in the RSC payload. A pointer now sits in the header comment of src/app/store/thanks/page.tsx, which is where the next person looks.

Also settled: preview deployments have never sent pixel events, and the cause is OUR hostname gate (§8.30-b), not Meta's domain allow list. It will not change if that allow list is edited, and production is the only place to test.

OBSERVABILITY FIX after the first real CAPI order (§8.30-q). Marketing asked whether the webhook fired and Meta accepted the event for KH-G7RD-96ZK, and it was UNANSWERABLE - not for lack of access, but because reportPurchaseToMeta logged only failures, so "sent" and "skipped" were both silent. The rule earned: a log that only fires on failure can answer "did it break", never "did it work". Every branch now logs [meta-capi] SENT|SKIPPED|REJECTED|FAILED <event_id>, success carrying events_received and fbtrace_id, skip naming META_CAPI_TOKEN. /api/health gained capi: configured|missing, presence only and never the value, same shape as the existing email field - so "did the env var land after the redeploy" is one curl. Tests assert the token appears in no log line and in no health response.
